interactives.label: Rules of the run
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the warden's house. Waystones count you out. The pool is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The bund
interactives.text: The bund keeps the river out of the paddies and the sluice houses keep the bund honest. Between the houses the bund is hollow. Things like a hollow.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Bund Run
gauntlet.flavour: The great bund that holds the paddies back from the river, hollow inside where the sluice houses join, and never quite dry.
